surface: symmetric unreconstructed primitive Cu(001) 1x1 clean slab
purpose: converge the clean substrate before introducing Na

analysis.surface_reference: for each vacuum/kmesh pair, fit E_slab(L)=mu*L+2*epsilon_surface across all four odd layer counts
analysis.vacuum_kmesh_rule: smallest vacuum/kmesh whose fitted surface excess differs by no more than 1.0 meV per surface atom from every dominating grid point
analysis.layer_rule: smallest layer count whose slab-consistent surface excess differs by no more than 1.0 meV per surface atom from every thicker registered slab
reported_diagnostics: slab-fit slope difference from independently fitted bulk e0

electrostatics: symmetric neutral clean slab under 3D periodic boundary conditions; no dipole correction
